words.name: seed
words.description: Deterministically reseed the interpreter's pseudorandom stream from an integer.

words.name: int
words.description: Return an unbiased integer from lower up to, but not including, upper.

words.name: float
words.description: Return a pseudorandom float greater than or equal to zero and less than one.

words.name: choice
words.description: Return one uniformly selected item from a non-empty vector, list, or string.

words.name: shuffle
words.description: Return a uniformly shuffled vector, list, or string while preserving its sequence type.
